verdict.rationale: Oyster is an EOR and payroll platform, so time-to-payroll is a fair axis. However, the evidence only documents multi-country payroll, automated time-off, and bonuses and allowances retrieval. Nothing shows hourly time entries or overtime being captured and fed into a payroll run. Time-off automation is an adjacent feature and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have hourly time entries and overtime flow directly into the payroll run
